name: Grama
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one seamless square ground texture for a premium dark fantasy virtual tabletop terrain brush. Create a NEW full-bleed square texture viewed exactly from vertically overhead, orthographic, no perspective or horizon. Match highly detailed naturalistic illustrated tree and rock tokens: realistic materials with restrained painterly finish, earthy nuanced colors, calm readable overall values so characters remain distinct. This is ground at tabletop scale, not a close-up macro photograph. Diffuse neutral overcast light, tiny contact shadows only. Seamlessly tile in both axes: opposite edges must join naturally, no frames, vignette, edge darkening, directional lighting gradient, identifiable repeating centerpiece, grid, text, objects, characters or watermark. Cover the whole canvas evenly with nonuniform organic material variation. Fine details and subtle medium-scale variation, avoid flat procedural noise or decorative fantasy patterns. Output only this single finished square material.
Subject: Low natural meadow grass: fine short olive and sage green blades, tufts and tiny clover, dry straw hints, sparse irregular spots of brown soil showing between blades. Muted living greens, medium dark earth underneath, subtle density variations. Detailed wild ground, no neon green, moss carpet, giant leaves or regular lawns.
